meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 安装后,当你要求审查已完成的工作时,Claude 会同时派出 5 个后台检查员,分别核对目标是否达成、代码质量、安全性、实际运行效果和相关背景资料,全部通过才算审查通过。
howto.when: 当你说出“review work”“QA my work”“check my work”等关键词,或明确要求审查已完成的工作,或准备提交 PR 前,会触发。

say.text: 帮我 review 一下这次改动。
say.note: 触发 5 个并行后台检查代理。

say.text: QA my work,重点测一下实际运行效果。
say.note: QA 执行代理会真正运行应用来验证。
按原文规定,PR 交接前应使用此技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to review completed work, Claude launches 5 parallel background checkers for goal verification, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining. All must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'review work', 'QA my work', 'check my work', etc., explicitly ask to review completed work, or before a PR handoff.

say_en.text: QA my work, focus on actual runtime behavior.
say_en.note: QA agent runs the app to test.

say_en.text: Verify implementation before I open the PR.
say_en.note: Skill is required before PR handoff.
